sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen-Agent: Agent framework and applications built upon ...
sources.snippet: Qwen-Agent is a framework for developing LLM applications based on the instruction following, tool usage, planning, and memory capabilities of Qwen. It also comes with example applications such as Browser Assistant, Code Interpreter, and Custom Assistant. Now Qwen-Agent plays as the backend of Qwen Chat.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.0 Released: Next-Gen 7B Image Model with Native 2K ...
sources.snippet: Alibaba's Qwen team launches Qwen-Image-2.0, a next-generation 7B parameter image foundation model achieving #1 on AI Arena in both text-to-image and image editing. With native 2K resolution, 1K-token prompt support for professional infographics, and a lighter architecture — it outperforms FLUX.1 (12B) on DPG-Bench with 88.32 vs 83.84.
